name: Alexanarch DOI→AXN map (derived)
description: Derived from data/doi-resolution-index.json (canonical) by scripts/sync_resolver.py. Value: [sovereign AXN or null, resolution URL or null]. quarantine_policy: entries with fragment-candidate identifiers, unresolved parent works, other-author classification, or unsupported namespaces emit null targets; see quarantine field per entry in canonical index
